website.note: Perrigo is a consumer self-care company (OTC, store-brand, infant formula, women's health Rx Opill). No traditional novel-drug development pipeline page.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Perrigo is a consumer self-care / OTC and store-brand pharmaceuticals company; its R&D consists of generic / OTC bioequivalence studies and product line extensions, not novel P1/P2/P3 NCE development. All Perrigo-sponsored ctgov studies are bioequivalence (P1) studies completed 2003-2016 and one COMPLETED P3 pseudoephedrine pediatric study. No active novel-asset clinical development trials identified.

commercial_product.note: Major commercial focus: Opill (norgestrel) OTC oral contraceptive (first OTC progestin-only pill in US, launched 2024), plus broad OTC portfolio (analgesics, GI, smoking cessation, infant formula).

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: P3 pseudoephedrine in children COMPLETED 2016 (regulatory study)
Investigator-initiated Vivomixx P1/P2 status UNKNOWN since 2021
